nom: Cetaphil Everyday Sunscreen Tinted Face Lotion SPF 40

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin are split: one with combination-oily skin found it surprisingly drying and never fully sank in, while another with oily skin says it keeps her face matte through the day without adding shine.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one in her 50s, describe the formula as moisturizing and well suited to dry skin.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin, including combination-sensitive and combination-oily, generally report no breakouts and good oil control, though one found it unexpectedly drying.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including several with rosacea or eczema, report reduced redness and irritation with no breakouts, though one reviewer with reactive rosacea-prone skin says it started stinging her face, which she traced to the alcohol in the formula.
segments.mature: The one reviewer who specifies dry, mature skin, in her 50s, found the formula worked well for her.

concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin found the formula moisturizing and non-flaking, but one reviewer with combination-oily skin found it unexpectedly drying no matter how she prepped her skin.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers with rosacea or generally reactive skin report the sunscreen calmed their redness and irritation, though one rosacea-prone reviewer experienced new stinging that she attributes to the alcohol in the formula.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers across skin types, including acne-prone reviewers and one using it while on accutane, consistently report the sunscreen does not cause breakouts or clogged pores.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin says it keeps her face matte throughout the day, while another with combination-oily skin found it left a persistent, unabsorbed, slippery feeling.

aspects.libelle: Single tint runs warm and orange on fair or cool-toned skin
Same single tint too light for medium-to-deep skin tones
Blends easily with no white cast for many skin tones
Pump often breaks or stops working
Doubles as a light-coverage foundation replacement

extraits.texte: The shades don't go light enough, as a fairer skinned girly that needs tinted protection, it's not even close to my shade. And I'm not even that light skinned.

I have combo/oily skin and i felt like this was super drying on my face, no matter how I prepped before applying. Also compared to other sunscreens I've tried this also never quite dried down on my face, like it always had a slippery feel to even hours after applying (I even used setting poweder to see if it helped). I will say though I never experienced any piling with this product and there isn't really a fragrance either. I would also say that if you are any darker than a light-medium skin tone this will probably be too light for you. I range between light-medium during the winter and medium during the summer months and this matches me perfectly for my winter shade but will definitely be too light once I get a little color.

extraits.titre: PERFECT IN EVERY WAY WITH 1 PROBLEM 💔
extraits.texte: When i say i have the most reactive sensitive rosacea prone skin and i LOVED this spf until it started slowly stinging my face and i look and realized it has ALCOHOL as the 3rd ingredient. Pls change the formula i love it too much 💔
I was in search for a tinted moisturizer and thought I would give this one a try. It works great. I am in my 50s and it works wonderful for dry and nature skin. The price is great too. I recommend.

could be perfect! doesn't make me oily or dry me out with my sensitive combo skin. also doesn't break me out which is so rare. so close to perfect but this would be amazing with other shade ranges.We need one with a cool pink undertone for us pale girls and i know that other women need a darker range. very few people are this shade of orange! is a case of trying to make something for everyone and falling short :( Please make more shades and i know it'll fly off the shelves!

extraits.titre: Perfect facial moisturizer with mineral sunscreen
extraits.texte: This is the perfect everyday moisturizer with mineral sunscreen! I have really sensitive combination skin that is prone to redness and this doesn't cause any irritation or redness at all. It feels light, creamy, and hydrating. I'm now using this every morning. After cleansing, I apply a light argan oil serum for dryness, and then layer this on top. I've stopped applying makeup afterward because I love the very light coverage this provides and I don't feel like I need anything else. This is basically the holy grail of face moisturizers for me. Love it!

I bought this a few weeks ago and am very pleased with the results and quality. The tint is perfect for my rosacea coverage and the overall coverage feels and looks great. Looking forward to continuing using long term. I also have oily skin and I feel this keeps my oily looking face matte thru the day. Does not make me look oilier at all.
